name: pi-tool-compact-display
description: Fork of pi-tool-display (by MasuRii) with left-padding alignment tweaks. Compact tool call rendering, diff visualization, and output truncation extension for Pi coding agent. Hides, collapses, and truncates verbose tool output for cleaner TUI display.
